settings.recall_definition: fraction of the item's planted flaws identified by >=1 critique of the condition's calls (judge label)
settings.severity_recall_definition: planted flaw identified by a critique whose merged group has severity high or critical

cost_definitions.mean_input / mean_output / mean_wall_sum: cost of the successful call of each record (last attempt)
cost_definitions.*_incl_retries: total over every attempt of each record, failed / retried ones included
cost_definitions.mean_failed_attempts: failed attempts per unit and condition
